thought.text: Production seed succeeded. Now the final documented production step — asset precompilation:

reasoning_content:
Excellent! `RAILS_ENV=production bin/rake db:seed` succeeded (exit 0). This is the documented production seed path (using `db/seeds.rb`, not the broken `db/dev_seeds.rb`). This means the production database has been seeded correctly.

Next, let's run `assets:precompile` for the production environment (the final step of the documented production setup, excluding capistrano/nginx etc. that don't apply to this container):

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && RAILS_ENV=production timeout 570 bin/rake assets:precompile > /tmp/precompile.log 2>&1; echo "PRECOMPILE EXIT=$?"; tail -8 /tmp/precompile.log
